name: lightcraft
notes: Runtime pin read by server/install.mjs (desktop.version) and the shared installer. Pinned 2026-11-06 to the v0.19.0 release (published 2026-11-06). Digests computed from the downloaded archives and matched against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt; bytes from GitHub asset metadata, matched against the downloads. SHA256SUMS.txt's detached signature (SHA256SUMS.txt.asc) verified with the release-signing-key.asc asset shipped in the same release: ed25519 primary key 2B76741B414AAD6CD33E631213A005C0B9D7C3ED (certify) with signing subkey 568DC1F68F8FAECC797F3C7B006DAF6BB0EF334E (the one SHA256SUMS.txt.asc is made with), asset sha256 8e6925a173d6a7134118da099948de4d9eeec7c1c0770998aec33c9d3f484740, the same bytes the v0.17.1/v0.18.1/v0.20.2 releases shipped; a re-pin compares the key against these values. The installer trusts only this lock's sha256 and bytes. The DMG holds only LightCraft.app, so macOS also installs the separately pinned lightcraft-cli payload from the same release; the Windows portable ZIP and the Linux tarball carry lightcraft-cli themselves, so the CLI lock has no row for them and upstream ships no separate CLI archive for those platforms. Licences: the app bundle carries LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE under Contents/Resources/Licenses, and the ZIP and tarball carry them at their roots, so no supplemental notice is needed. The control port is still unauthenticated at 0.19.0: the adapter verifies the listening process against the installed release before any request. Since 0.18.1 a desktop launch with a library offers the lensfun lens database download once, in a dialog with Download and Not Now; a headless session reads the database the desktop downloaded and never fetches it. Exercised at this pin by scripts/extensions/prove-lightcraft-drive.ts on darwin-arm64: clean download, size and SHA-256 check, offline tree validation, codesign, headless import/develop/export; the drive's window leg (--gui) did not run at this pin. Download only this URL; never select latest at install time.
